title: Savoy councilman collapses, dies during Tuesday meeting
text:
The Paris News
Established 1869
Serving Northeast Texas and Southeast Oklahoma
132nd year, No. 195

Thursday, February 21, 2002

Savoy councilman collapses, dies during Tuesday meeting

ASSOCIATED PRESS

SAVOY — A City Council member in Savoy collapsed and died during a meeting this week.

Councilman Harold Ballard collapsed at a meeting table on Tuesday night and was pronounced dead a short time later at Wilson N. Jones Medical Center, officials said.

A funding cut for the volunteer fire department was being discussed when Ballard slumped down in his chair, said firefighter R. L. Munger.

Another firefighter came forward and administered CPR.

Ballard was elected to the council last May and was a former high school science teacher.

City Hall was closed Wednesday and the flag was flown at half-staff.

Savoy, which has about 1,000 residents, is about 50 miles west of Paris in Fannin County.
